seal.statement: Starting from exact clean 82b54ef9b7c8d6be9f2d6450cbc5e6713ade00af and preserving the sealed raft-rs operation-port contract, canonical system mutations are admitted, proposed and applied only through existing semantic owners. A reference obtainable from the production registry/provider/router/query/CDC/bootstrap composition cannot reach a raw SQLite connection or statement, arbitrary local mutation function, semantic Raft proposal operation, committed-apply callback, mutable proposal or pending state, invocable private handler, raw socket/server/client, or equivalent alias. PartitionService and MessageRouter keep those implementation capabilities private and expose only named operations and immutable observations. The protected policy is specialized and owner-derived: MessageGroupServiceRowOwner with ReplicaStateMachine owns exact handler-bound SERVICES registration/lifecycle activation; partition service-row creation, ReplicaStateMachine and ReplicaCleanupTombstoneOwner own their exact SERVICES identity, lifecycle, created_at, create_attempt_token and cleanup_token transitions; ReplicaOperationRepository/RebalanceCoordinator own operation rows, workflow fields, and the current creation-time message-group membership tuple with its unique per-group lane, lost-answer adoption/reopen, terminal/update preservation; ReplicaCreateAdmissionOwner owns the durable create_admission CAS. No current post-insert membership phase transition is a positive of this Quest. The same fresh matching payload succeeds from the named current owner and has zero effect from generic gateway, CDC, QUERY, SYSTEM_TABLE_WRITE, FORWARD_WRITE, transaction, bootstrap or migration aliases without that owner capability. No table-wide ban silently captures unrelated fields: every protected field set has one named owner and every unclassified field stops for judgment. Protected system-metadata mutation consumes an exact existing-owner capability before proposal; committed/replayed bytes enter application only through the existing runtime transaction owner's exact captured callback. Serialized origin, purpose, type, digest, node id, boot scalar, copied command or copied committed record is never authority. Local leader, follower redirect, remote leader, retry, replay, managed-split child creation and handler/boot replacement preserve the same private route. Ordinary supported application SQL and DDL, explicitly owner-authorized system mutations, transactions, CDC, bootstrap/rejoin, snapshot catch-up, split/recovery, ACK/reconnect/pressure and restart continue through their existing owners without a second persistence, consensus, router, authentication, workflow or row-lifecycle owner. A whole-graph capability ledger strictly decreases and controlled aliases restore every red escape.
